findings.note: Replaced .build() with .body(errorBody) where errorBody is a Map with status=400, error='Bad Request', message='"from" must not be after "to"'. Structured error body now matches the contract.

GlobalExceptionHandler now extends ResponseEntityExceptionHandler. Added @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException.class) returning ErrorResponse(400). Overrode handleHttpMessageNotReadable to return ErrorResponse(400, 'Bad Request', 'Malformed JSON request') instead of Spring's default empty body.
Added null guard: if (conf.getStatus() != null) { existing.setStatus(conf.getStatus().toUpperCase()); }. A PUT body omitting status no longer causes NullPointerException.
Added conferenceRepository.findById(id).orElseThrow(ResourceNotFoundException) before the session query in getConferenceSessions. Missing conference now returns 404 instead of empty 200.
Added conferenceRepository.findById(conferenceId).orElseThrow(ResourceNotFoundException) at the start of getRegistrations. Missing conference now returns 404 instead of empty list with 200.
Added registrationRepository.existsById(registrationId) check before the conference-membership check. An absent registration now throws ResourceNotFoundException (404) before the mismatch check runs.

Created RegistrationServiceTest with three tests: deleteRegistration_registrationNotFound_shouldThrowResourceNotFoundException, deleteRegistration_registrationBelongsToDifferentConference_shouldThrowRegistrationMismatchException, getRegistrations_conferenceNotFound_shouldThrowResourceNotFoundException. All three pass.

Investigated: @WebMvcTest(controllers = TestController.class) configures a type-filter only; it does NOT register the bean independently. TestController is a static inner class of the test class and is not in any component-scan base package, so it is registered exactly once — via @Import. Removing it from @Import broke all four GlobalExceptionHandlerTest tests (all endpoints returned 404). The original setup causes no actual BeanDefinitionOverrideException in Spring Boot 2.7.14 and is preserved.

Added three ResourceNotFoundException tests: getConference_notFound_shouldThrowResourceNotFoundException, updateConference_notFound_shouldThrowResourceNotFoundException, createSession_conferenceNotFound_shouldThrowResourceNotFoundException. All pass.
Added updateSession_notFound_shouldThrowResourceNotFoundException mirroring the getSession_notFound pattern. Passes.

Updated getConferenceRegistrations to: const res = await response.json(); return res.data ?? res; This unwraps the {data:[...]} envelope before returning, so ConferenceDetailPage.jsx:66 receives the array directly and Array.isArray(data) is true. The existing setRegistrations(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []) line required no change.
